l1_candidates.rationale: Cross-module authority boundary between Reducer and Read Model is explicit and repeatedly verified.

l1_candidates.rule: Read and write authority must be separated.
l1_candidates.rationale: Implementation-independent authority separation is reusable across modules.

l1_candidates.rule: Predictable rejection and unexpected exception must be routed separately.
l1_candidates.rationale: The rule is implementation-independent and has deterministic negative-path evidence.

l1_candidates.rule: Rejection paths must not fabricate a normal business result.
l1_candidates.rationale: The rule prevents semantic falsification and can be reused across modules.

l1_candidates.rule: Candidate outputs must preserve provenance, trace, and version.
l1_candidates.rationale: Preservation is verified across three phases and does not depend on internal structure.

l1_candidates.rule: Runtime boundary flags must be explicit.
l1_candidates.rationale: Explicit boundary evidence is reusable for controlled runtimes.

l1_candidates.rule: A verifier must not implicitly repeat runner execution.
l1_candidates.rationale: Preserves execution authority and report integrity; formal admission remains pending cross-module governance review.

l1_candidates.rule: Module integration requires skeleton, contract dry-run, and controlled runtime evidence first.
l1_candidates.rationale: The evidence cadence is module-independent and verified by the integration chain.

module_only_rules.rule: Reducer is the only Field State mutation authority.
Read Model only owns read/query/projection authority.
Read Model must not write state or admit facts.
Read Model six-state priority remains fixed.
Read Model runtime five-state set remains fixed.
Predictable Read Model contract rejection must not enter contained-error routing.
Read Model rejection path must not call its read API to fabricate a result.
Read Model trace/replay/version/provenance fields must be preserved.
Read Model input objects must remain immutable.
Read Model candidate outputs must not be upgraded into facts.
